title: Mei's 48-Hour Rule Kept $2,040 This Year

scenes.say: $260 a month, gone on little impulse buys.
That's about $3,120 a year, on things she barely remembers.
So she tried one rule: anything over $20 waits 48 hours in the cart.
She also unsubscribed from sale emails. Still wanted it two days later? She bought it.

items.text: Over $20? It waits in the cart
Still want it in 48h? Buy it

scenes.say: Most carts got deleted. Her spending fell to about $90 a month.
That's $170 a month, roughly $2,040 kept in a year.
